section.title: Required entries
section.para: The root directory of a DHS system MUST contain the following entries and SHOULD NOT contain others.

row.entry: The home directory of the root user.
A symbolic link to /overlayer/syshub/var, kept because the kernel interfaces and service managers of today expect /var to exist. It is the only symbolic link at the root.

section.title: Entries that must not exist
section.para: The following FHS directories MUST NOT exist at the root, neither as directories nor as symbolic links: /usr, /bin, /sbin, /lib, /lib32, /lib64, /libx32, /etc and /boot. Their contents live in the layers; lists where.
Keeping these names absent is what makes the layers enforceable: a program cannot write into /usr/lib and thereby into the base, because there is no such directory to write into.
